chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot to shorten his hair or shave it until he departed from Mina. He said: He returns to Mina until he discards his hair there, whether it was by shaving or shortening.
ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if they forget to cut their hair before leaving Mina?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadi‘ (AS) via Hammad al-Halabi, clarifying that the ritual hair cutting (halq or qasr) is a mandatory pillar of Hajj that cannot be omitted due to forgetfulness. The Imam’s directive to return to Mina emphasizes the strict chronological sequence of Hajj rites, ensuring the pilgrim fulfills the obligation of exiting the state of Ihram in its proper location before proceeding to Mecca.
